Delete an Attendance Record

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to delete a wrong or duplicate attendance record. Attendance records cannot be archived, only deleted.

1. Open Attendances

Open the Attendances app.

2. Switch to List

Click List to see the records as a table.

3. Find the employee

Type the employee's name and press Enter.

4. Open the group

Click the employee's group to show the attendance records.

Screenshot pending — run the pipeline again to capture it.

5. Select it

Tick the box in front of the attendance record.

Screenshot pending — run the pipeline again to capture it.

6. Actions

Click Actions.

Screenshot pending — run the pipeline again to capture it.

7. Delete

Click Delete.

8. Confirm

Click Delete in the window to confirm.
